**Steps to reproduce the issue:**
1. docker run --privileged -id --name sw debian bash
2. sudo ./create_vnet.sh sw
3. docker run --privileged -v /var/run/redis-vs/sw:/var/run/redis --network container:sw -d --name vs docker-sonic-vs
4. sudo pytest -s -v test_port.py --dvsname=vs

**Describe the results you received:**

resolution.title: [dvs] Update README with new flags, options, and known issues
resolution.description:
- Document --keeptb flag
- Add dynamic port option to ./create_vnet.sh
- Add `libswsscommon` installation issue

Signed-off-by: Danny Allen <<EMAIL>>

**What I did**
I added some additional info to the README for the docker virtual switch.

**Why I did it**
Fixes #1324

**How I verified it**
Tried the specified options locally.
